objective_for_doctor: A 9-year-old Female patient presents to the clinic. Chief complaint: I have heavy pain, top of the head pain, and left temple pain.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi. I have a heavy pain on the top of my head and also pain in my left temple. I also have a sore throat and a clear runny nose, and I’ve been around someone who had similar symptoms in the last couple weeks.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—when did the head/temple pain start, and is it constant or coming in episodes?  
Doctor: Do you have fever, nausea/vomiting, sensitivity to light or sound, or any vision changes?

It started recently, and it came on pretty fast. The pain feels heavy and it’s been 7 out of 10, but I don’t know if it’s in episodes or constant—I can feel it most of the time.  

I don’t know about fever or nausea/vomiting, and I don’t have vision changes. I’m not sure about being sensitive to light or sound.

Doctor: Any fever (measured temp), neck stiffness, rash, or severe worsening with coughing/straining—and does it hurt more when you lie down?  
Doctor: Also, is the runny nose/sore throat still going, and have you been able to drink/eat normally (any dehydration or very sleepy behavior)?

I don’t have a measured fever, and I don’t have a rash. I’m not sure about neck stiffness. It hasn’t gotten severely worse with coughing or straining, and I don’t think it hurts more when I lie down.  

The runny nose and sore throat are still there. I can drink and eat normally, and I’m not very sleepy or dehydrated.

Doctor: Any tenderness or redness over the left temple/scalp, and do you have a toothache or pain when chewing?  
Doctor: Does she have frequent headaches before this, and what are her age-appropriate vital signs if you know them (heart rate/temp), plus any recent head injury?

I don’t know if there is tenderness or redness on the left temple or scalp. I don’t have a toothache or pain when chewing.  

I usually don’t get headaches like this before. I don’t know her exact heart rate or temperature, and I haven’t had any head injury recently.

Doctor: I’m going to do a quick targeted exam—can you check if pressing the left temple/scalp reproduces the pain, and also ask: any pain moving the eyes, new droopy eyelid, weakness/numbness, or trouble speaking?  
Doctor: Also, do the headaches wake her from sleep, and what’s her current temperature if you can measure it now?  
Doctor: REQUEST TEST: Rapid_Strep_Test (or throat culture if not available)

When you press the left temple/scalp, it feels like it could reproduce the pain, but I can’t be 100% sure. I don’t have pain moving my eyes, and I don’t have a new droopy eyelid. I also don’t have weakness/numbness or trouble speaking.  

The headache doesn’t wake me from sleep. I don’t have a temperature measured right now.  

For the throat test—I haven’t had a rapid strep test yet.

Doctor: Thanks—given the fast-onset 7/10 unilateral left temple/top-of-head pain plus sore throat/runny nose and no neuro red flags, I’d like to confirm infection first. REQUEST TEST: Rapid_Strep_Test (if negative, consider throat culture) and REQUEST TEST: Vital_Signs (measured temp/HR).

Doctor: While that’s pending, can you tell me whether the headache worsens with coughing/straining or after getting up in the morning, and whether she has had any recent dental pain or facial swelling?

It doesn’t really get worse with coughing or straining. I’m not sure about after getting up in the morning.  

I don’t have recent dental pain and I don’t have facial swelling.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—since there’s unilateral temple/top-of-head pain plus sore throat/runny nose with no neuro red flags, do you have any swollen/tender neck glands or bad breath, and do you see white patches or redness in the throat?  
Doctor: Also, is the pain tender to touch over a small spot on the temple/scalp, and on a scale of 0–10 how intense is it now?  
REQUEST TEST: Rapid_Strep_Test (if not already done)

I don’t know about swollen or tender neck glands or bad breath. I also don’t know if I see white patches or redness in my throat.  

The pain feels tender when you touch a small spot on the temple/scalp, and right now it’s still about 7 out of 10. I haven’t had a rapid strep test yet.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—do you have a fever now (measured temp), and does she have swollen/tender glands under the jaw/neck?  
Doctor: Also, can you look in the mirror: are there white patches on her tonsils/throat, and are there any new blisters/sores on the scalp or around the ear (behind the ear)?  
Doctor: REQUEST TEST: Measured_Temperature_&_Heart_Rate and REQUEST TEST: Throat_Exam_for_exudate (rapid strep if available)

I don’t have a measured temperature or heart rate right now. I also can’t check or confirm swollen/tender glands under the jaw/neck.  

I can’t reliably see in the mirror for white patches in the throat, and I don’t know about any new blisters or sores on the scalp or around the ear behind the ear.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—based on her fast-onset unilateral 7/10 temple/top-head pain with ongoing sore throat and clear runny nose (and no neuro red flags like vision changes, weakness, or worsening with lying down/coughing), my leading concern is a viral upper respiratory illness with headache, but I must exclude strep/serious secondary causes; can you measure her temperature now and confirm whether the left temple/scalp is tender to light touch or just to pressing on one spot?  
Doctor: REQUEST TEST: Measured_Temperature_&_Heart_Rate (now) and REQUEST TEST: Rapid_Strep_Test (or throat culture)

I can’t measure her temperature or heart rate right now.  

The left temple/scalp feels tender when you press on one small spot, not just when touched lightly over the whole area. I haven’t had a rapid strep test yet.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—since we can’t measure vitals and there’s focal left temple/scalp tenderness plus viral-URI symptoms, can you confirm: any swollen lymph nodes under the jaw/neck, and any redness or warmth over that tender spot?  
Doctor: Also, any recent ear pain or pain when pulling on the ear, and has she had any new rash anywhere?

I don’t know if there are swollen lymph nodes under the jaw/neck. I also don’t know if the tender spot is red or warm.  

I don’t have recent ear pain, and I don’t know about pain when pulling on the ear. I also don’t have a new rash anywhere.

Doctor: Given her quick-onset 7/10 unilateral left temple/top-of-head pain with a localized tender scalp spot and concurrent sore throat/runny clear rhinorrhea in a sick-contact, this most fits a viral URI–associated headache, but we must rule out strep urgently—can you please do a **measured temperature now** and have her get a **Rapid_Strep_Test** today?  
Doctor: Also, during the exam, do you see any **scalp swelling, redness, or a small pus-filled spot** over that tender point, and does she have **pain when brushing hair** or **any new rash around the ear/eyelid**?

I can’t measure her temperature right now. I also haven’t had a rapid strep test today yet.  

During the exam, I haven’t been able to confirm scalp swelling, redness, or any pus-filled spot, and I don’t know about pain when brushing her hair. I also don’t know about any new rash around the ear or eyelid.

Doctor: I’m going to proceed with the most likely diagnosis: a viral upper-respiratory infection causing a headache; however, because the pain is severe (7/10) and focal at the left temple/scalp, we still need to exclude strep and rare serious causes—did the headache start after any new infection exposure (you already mentioned sick contact), and does she have any ear/scalp infection signs like worsening pain when chewing, persistent scalp crusting, or pain behind the ear?

Doctor: Next, REQUEST TEST: Rapid_Strep_Test (and measure temp/HR at the visit); if negative but symptoms persist/worsen or temp is high, we may need further evaluation for other causes of unilateral head pain.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Viral upper-respiratory infection with associated headache (rule out streptococcal pharyngitis; no current neurologic red flags reported)
